name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of Shadowcrafting) — 2 Intermediate — Coruscating Shadow

system.description:
A writhing globe of shadow surrounds you at arm's length, granting a one-Trait bonus to resolving Stealth challenges and to defending against physical attacks, thanks to the disorienting, strobing shapes that flit across its surface.

This path does not function against or for Kindred with the Flaw: Cast No Reflection.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
system.duration: One turn per point of permanent Willpower
